notes: Mixed explicit markers and prose; includes a decision reversal (Chart.js -> Recharts). Ground truth relabelled to transcript spans, not hindsight summaries.

messages.content: Building a real-time analytics dashboard with React and WebSockets
Starting dashboard project. Creating: src/App.tsx, src/components/Dashboard.tsx, src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts
Use TypeScript and Recharts for charts
Decided: TypeScript for type safety. Decided: Recharts for data visualization (good React integration). Completed: project scaffold with Vite.
The chart is not updating in real time
Fixed: WebSocket message not triggering re-render — was missing dependency in useEffect. Updated src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts. Chart now updates live.
Decided: CSS variables for theming (no extra library). Completed: dark mode toggle in src/components/Header.tsx. Updated src/styles/theme.css.
Going with JWT stored in httpOnly cookie (not localStorage — XSS safe). Working on: src/hooks/useAuth.ts, src/components/Login.tsx
